description: Art provenance search. Filtered search over the Ni Biashara art provenance shelf: museum collection records with structured provenance chains, continuity grades and documented transfer counts. Filter by text, artist, holding institution, medium or a transfer-count floor. Prices are never estimated — the price layer is named as a gap per record. $0.25 USDC on Base. Returns the x402 URL to GET (402 → PAYMENT-SIGNATURE → delivery). Free to call this tool; payment happens on the URL.

artist.description: artist name text, e.g. Peter Paul Rubens (optional)

institution.description: holding institution name text, e.g. Cleveland Museum of Art (optional)

limit.description: max records to return (optional, default 25, max 60)

medium.description: medium text, e.g. Oil on canvas (optional)

min_transfers.description: only records with at least this many documented transfers (optional)

q.description: free text over work title and artist (optional)

name: search_art_provenance
title: Art provenance search
